lines.en: Timba, let!

lines.en: You really cannot catch them, or find their whereabouts.

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!

lines.en: Tom Thomas! Tom Thomas! OK.

lines.en: Simka, Toola, check it out. It's pretty, isn't it?
lines.zh: 辛科·图拉，看看它，很漂亮，不是吗？哦

lines.en: Splendid! It's nothing but a trinket. It's completely useless.
lines.zh: 太棒了！它不过是个小玩意儿，完全没用。

lines.en: Useless? Look how well it matches my hair clip.
lines.zh: 没用！看看它和我的发夹多搭！

lines.en: Useful things are the kinds of things that are useful to me.
lines.zh: 有用的东西是你真正需要的那种东西

lines.en: you truly need. For instance, like this rope ladder I've got. It's splendid!
lines.zh: 比如我这个绳梯，它很棒！

lines.en: And where do you plan on climbing with this thing?
lines.zh: 你打算把它放在哪里？现在带着这玩意儿爬山

lines.en: Now this mirror here is both useful and pretty.
lines.zh: 这面镜子既实用又漂亮

lines.en: Oh, how splendid! Toola, you say everything is splendid.
lines.zh: 哦，太棒了，金枪鱼，你说一切都很棒，好吧

lines.en: Well, here's something super splendid that I bet you don't have.
lines.zh: 这里有个超级棒的东西，我敢打赌你没有

lines.en: What is it? It's a mechanical superclaw.
lines.zh: 哦，是什么？一个机械超级爪子

lines.en: It must be just perfect for scratching your back.
lines.zh: 挠背肯定很完美

lines.en: Now look what I have! A photograph of Vector!
lines.zh: 现在看，我有一张Vector的照片

lines.en: And he signed it for me too. Are you sure that's Vector?
lines.zh: 他还给我签了名，你确定那是Vector吗？

lines.en: You've got a photo of the bravest
lines.zh: 你有一张照片，上面是

lines.en: Fixie on the face of the entire planet?
lines.zh: 地球上最勇敢的小精灵

lines.en: Yeah, and the most beautiful. Is it him for sure?
lines.zh: 是啊，最漂亮的肯定不是他

lines.en: No way! Let me take a look! Uh -uh.
lines.zh: 不可能，让我看看，呃呃

lines.en: You'll smudge it! You've been fooled! No!
lines.zh: 你会弄脏的，你上当了，不，是的

lines.en: Yes! Jealous? You are!
lines.zh: 你上当了，哦

lines.en: My photo! Oh, no! What was that?
lines.zh: 我的照片，哦不，那是什么？

lines.en: A draught! This is completely your fault!
lines.zh: 呃，草稿，这完全是你的错

lines.en: It's not my fault, it's your fault for bragging so much!
lines.zh: 不是我的错，是你的错，你太爱吹牛了，拜托

lines.en: Please, girls, stop fighting! Let's go find it!
lines.zh: 女孩们别吵了，我们去找吧，所以

lines.en: It's just horrible to lose a picture signed by the most famous fixie ever!
lines.zh: 弄丢一张有史以来最著名的固定齿轮自行车手的签名照真是太糟糕了

lines.en: It will be horrible when that picture of a fixie is found by humans!
lines.zh: 太糟糕了 当人类找到那张固定齿轮自行车的照片时

lines.en: So where could it be? I know how we can find it! Exactly!
lines.zh: 它会在哪里呢？我知道我们该如何找到它。

lines.en: We'll blow a bubble and watch which way it goes as it floats away.
lines.zh: 我们吹一个泡泡，观察它飘向远方的方向

lines.en: We'll follow it and find your picture.
lines.zh: 然后跟着它找到你的照片。

lines.en: Do you know why you can blow bubbles out of soapy water?
lines.zh: 你知道为什么在任何液体的表面都能吹出肥皂泡吗？

lines.en: At the surface of any liquid there is an
lines.zh: 在任何液体的表面都有

lines.en: invisible film that is very thick but very strong.
lines.zh: 一层非常薄但非常坚固的隐形薄膜

lines.en: If you want to see it for yourself,
lines.zh: 如果你想亲眼看看

lines.en: fill up a glass with water all the way to the very top.
lines.zh: 就把一杯水倒满。现在

lines.en: Now you need to take a coin
lines.zh: 你拿一枚硬币

lines.en: and carefully drop it into the water sideways.
lines.zh: 小心地把它侧着扔进水里，然后再扔一枚

lines.en: Then drop in another coin, and another, and another.
lines.zh: 再一枚，再一枚。

lines.en: You'll see that the water doesn't pour
lines.zh: 你会发现水不会流出来

lines.en: out but rises up and forms a hump.
lines.zh: 而是会上升

lines.en: That's because the water at the top sticks together.
lines.zh: 形成一个凸起。

lines.en: Why? Because of a force called surface tension.
lines.zh: 这是因为水面的液体因为表面张力而聚集在一起。

lines.en: Thanks to surface tension, water can form drops.
lines.zh: 正是由于表面张力，水才能形成水滴。

lines.en: It also helps us blow soap bubbles.
lines.zh: 它也帮助我们吹肥皂泡

lines.en: Because when we add soap into the water, the fume gets even stronger,
lines.zh: 因为当我们在水中加入肥皂时，这层薄膜会变得更坚固

lines.en: but still not strong enough to stop the bubbles from bursting.
lines.zh: 但仍然不足以阻止泡泡破裂。

lines.en: OK, it's ready. Now we need to blow!
lines.zh: 好了，准备好了

lines.en: Do it together! And… I don't think this way is going to work.
lines.zh: 现在我们需要……（音乐）一起做……（音乐）我觉得这条路行不通…… 工作

lines.en: Look, it's flying! We did it! The vent!
lines.zh: 看，它飞起来了！我们成功了！通风口！

lines.en: Of course! Why didn't I think of that before?
lines.zh: 当然，我之前怎么没想到呢？

lines.en: Have you ever seen holes in the
lines.zh: 你见过

lines.en: bathroom or kitchen that are covered with grids?
lines.zh: 浴室或厨房里那些用格栅盖住的洞吗

lines.en: Well, those are called vents.
lines.zh: 那些叫做通风口

lines.en: And behind the vent is a long pipe called an air duct.
lines.zh: 通风口后面是一根叫做风管的长管子。

lines.en: Unpleasant odors and musty air can be forced
lines.zh: 难闻的气味和霉味会被强制送入风管

lines.en: into the ducts and sent out of the house.
lines.zh: 然后排出室外。

lines.en: And if you want that old, stale air to leave the house even faster,
lines.zh: 如果你想让那些陈旧的空气更快地离开房子

lines.en: open a window and let in some of the fresh air from outside.
lines.zh: 那就打开窗户，让一些新鲜空气从外面进来

lines.en: Keep the air in your home as fresh as it can be.
lines.zh: 保持家里的空气尽可能清新。

lines.en: Hey, take a look! It got stuck over there!
lines.zh: 嘿，看！它卡在那边了，快把它抓住

lines.en: Get it before it flies away! How can we grab it?
lines.zh: 不然它就要飞走了。我们怎么抓住它？

lines.en: What do you mean?
lines.zh: 什么意思？

lines.zh: 辛卡。如果没有你的机械爪和你那神奇的梯子

lines.en: And your fantastic ladder! Then here you go!
lines.zh: 我们该怎么办？

lines.zh: 给你，这是送给你的礼物。

lines.zh: 哦，谢谢，它太棒了！我想把这个送给你。

lines.en: Oh, gee! It's just splendid!
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，它真是太棒了！

lines.zh: 辛卡，你在吗？嗯？什么？你那儿有个小镜子

lines.en: A little mirror. It's pretty, don't you think?
lines.zh: 挺漂亮的，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: Oh, you girls. You're all the same.
lines.zh: 哦，你们这些女孩都一样。
